name: alpha-source-gate
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; SHA=ed33f406d61ac50918cff1d69c81cbf843eebf417eb05091544a082f80def1fe; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.source-projection.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; bun test research/bapa/source-projection.test.ts research/bapa/retained-export.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/proof-emit.ts --capture alpha-consensus --sha256 "$SHA" --out "$OUT/positive" --projection alpha > "$OUT/emission.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/positive"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$OUT/lean.log" BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/axioms.log" 2>&1; cd "$ROOT"; for kind in body capture; do bun research/bapa/source-projection-control.ts alpha-consensus "$SHA" "$kind" "$OUT/$kind" > "$OUT/$kind-emission.log" 2>&1; cp -a "$OUT/positive/.lake" "$OUT/$kind/.lake"; cd "$OUT/$kind"; set +e; lake env lean BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/$kind-lean.log" 2>&1; code=$?; set -e; test "$code" -ne 0; grep -Eq 'BapaProof[.]lean:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: error:' "$OUT/$kind-lean.log"; cd "$ROOT"; done; mkdir "$OUT/tampered"; cp -a alpha-consensus/. "$OUT/tampered/"; bun -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),p=process.env.SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR+"/tampered/CAPTURE.json",m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p));m.identity.protocol="wrong_protocol";fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(m))'; set +e; bun research/bapa/proof-emit.ts --capture "$OUT/tampered" --sha256 "$SHA" --out "$OUT/forbidden" --projection alpha > "$OUT/tamper.log" 2>&1; code=$?; set -e; test "$code" -ne 0; test ! -e "$OUT/forbidden/EMITTED.json"; printf '%s\n' 'feat(bapa): check alpha source projection in Lean' > "$OUT/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$OUT/commit-message.txt" > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1
